_doc: Cross-promotion registry. Brands, the CLAIMS made about them (each with a verification status and sourcing), and PROMOS that place a brand on a surface. Rendering is done by scripts/promo.mjs, which is independent of the bookstore so other sites can reuse it. A production build (FM_ENV=production) refuses to run while any placed promo is unapproved, has no URL, or relies on an unverified claim or an unauthorised badge. See docs/CROSS-PROMOTION.md.

nvidiaInception.note: BLOCKED: no official NVIDIA Inception asset or Inception-specific branding guidance is available to this project. NVIDIA's general logo page says its logo may not be distorted, recoloured, stylised or rearranged, may only be used as expressly authorised in writing, and that use of the NVIDIA logo can imply partnership or endorsement; its older partner guidelines say to use NVIDIA-provided badge assets under the guideline issued to the member. The NVIDIA panel visible in the owner's artwork is part of a composite image, not an NVIDIA-supplied file, so it is NOT reused. Until the owner supplies the official Inception badge from the Inception member portal together with its usage terms (and written approval if required), the site shows only the plain-text membership statement. To enable: place the file in assets-src/partner/, set asset, licenseConfirmed true, guidelinesUrl and guidelinesReviewedOn.
